input: Read /data/org.json which has a nested structure of teams with members. Extract all unique member names across all teams, sort them alphabetically, and print one per line.

tool_calls:
jq -r '.teams[].members[].name' /data/org.json | sort -u
echo "---try jq---"
which jq; jq --version 2>&1
# fallback if no jq: grep method
grep -o '"name":"[^"]*"' /data/org.json | head
